name: Exploration
core_loop: Stand on an island and spot the next landmark
Cross the gap with a jump and a glide
Collect the pickup that drew you there
Watch the objective counter move and choose the next island

questions.question: How does the player cross the gaps between islands?
How much world should the first build hold?

acceptance.promise: Holding jump in the air glides at a fixed fall speed and reaches the next island.
setup: Load the first island pair with the authored gap_distance
Place the player on the launch edge facing the far island
probes: Jump, hold the glide input and sample vertical speed every frame
Record the horizontal distance travelled before the player lands
evidence: Vertical speed while gliding equals glide_fall_speed within tolerance
The landing point is on the far island collider

acceptance.promise: Collecting the target number of pickups unlocks the goal and ends the run as a win.
setup: Spawn exactly collect_target pickups across the islands
probes: Teleport the player through each pickup volume in order
Read the HUD counter after every pickup
Enter the goal volume once the counter is full
evidence: The goal reports unlocked exactly once
Entering the goal raises the win result
